headline: Renames a Postal Service building in McKeesport, Pennsylvania, after First Sergeant Leonard A. Funk, Jr.
what_it_does: This law names the United States Postal Service facility at 850 Walnut Street in McKeesport, Pennsylvania, the First Sergeant Leonard A. Funk, Jr. Post Office Building. It changes only the building's official name. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 27, 2022.
